The exact product factorization, skew-symmetry reduction, hostile-case checks, and BSSC specialization are supplied and accepted. Only limited independent assimilation, interface checking, and reuse work remains when this program is pursued.

Substantial exploratory work remains for coupled UV branches, nonsymmetric or weighted scalarizations, nested envelopes, and richer auxiliary constraints not covered by the theorem. Incidence is limited because the manifested scalar result cannot improve the current certified upper bound.
